desc:
Mine geodes, crack them open and find the rarest crystals in the caves! ⛏️

👥 SQUAD UP: Play solo or bring up to 3 friends down with you.
🪨 MINE: Dig through huge geode piles, fill your bag and get back up the lift before it’s too late.
💥 CRACK: Open your geodes at camp and see what you pulled. Some are super rare!
⬆️ UPGRADE: Get better tools, bigger bags and upgrades with your cash and gems.
🐾 PETS & CLASSES: Hatch pets that dig with you and pick a class that fits how you play.
🌋 CHAPTERS: Unlock new caves like the Molten Deep, then try HARD mode or see how deep you can go in ENDLESS.
🏆 Beat the bosses and climb the leaderboards!

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for more updates!
